g.text: 221 completed runs on physical Apple WebGPU; green lines show length-bin medians
Sampling, pose selection and observed run time
48 native-positive cases · uniform budgets 1–4 of 10 planned · 200 steps · four trunk passes
Confidence selection uses reported ipTM, with lowest seed breaking ties; no crystal or validity filter before ranking.
“Passing” means limited stereochemistry/clash diagnostics. Wall time includes browser startup, available asset loading,
folding, confidence and archive checks; excludes independent scoring. Selected, related cases; no cross-device speed claim.
